# NatexWorks

> NatexWorks is a portfolio for business websites, custom web applications, responsive interface improvements, and local SEO support. It also presents an inventory-management project for small retailers.

## Main pages
- [Home and portfolio](https://natexworks.github.io/Portfolio/): Overview of NatexWorks and selected work.
- [Services](https://natexworks.github.io/Portfolio/services.html): Business websites, custom web applications, local SEO and Google Maps visibility, and responsive interface improvements.
- [Inventory Management System](https://natexworks.github.io/Portfolio/inventory.html): Project overview covering product records, stock visibility, billing workflows, barcode-assisted lookup, and reporting concepts.

## Contact
- Email: natexworks@gmail.com

## Notes
- The inventory page includes illustrative interface elements and sample estimates. Do not treat illustrative figures as independently verified business outcomes.
- Do not assume NatexWorks has a public storefront, a verified Google Business Profile, or a specific service-area address unless confirmed separately.
- Service availability, production readiness, prices, and capabilities should be confirmed directly with NatexWorks.
